title: Advanced Sampling Methods for Multiscale Simulation of Disordered Proteins and Dynamic Interactions.
authors: Gong, Xiping; Zhang, Yumeng; Chen, Jianhan
one_liner_zh: 该综述系统评述了无序蛋白多尺度模拟中的先进采样方法，聚焦IDP动态互作的机制建模，虽无新方法但深度契合本课题的方法与对象轴。
abstract: Intrinsically disordered proteins (IDPs) are highly prevalent and play important roles in biology and human diseases. It is now also recognized that many IDPs remain dynamic even in specific complexes and functional assemblies. Computer simulations are essential for deriving a molecular description of the disordered protein ensembles and dynamic interactions for a mechanistic understanding of IDPs in biology, diseases, and therapeutics. Here, we provide an in-depth review of recent advances in the multi-scale simulation of disordered protein states, with a particular emphasis on the development and application of advanced sampling techniques for studying IDPs. These techniques are critical for adequate sampling of the manifold functionally relevant conformational spaces of IDPs. Together with dramatically improved protein force fields, these advanced simulation approaches have achieved substantial success and demonstrated significant promise towards the quantitative and predictive modeling of IDPs and their dynamic interactions. We will also discuss important challenges remaining in the atomistic simulation of larger systems and how various coarse-grained approaches may help to bridge the remaining gaps in the accessible time- and length-scales of IDP simulations.
abstract_zh: intrinsically disordered proteins (IDPs) 在生物体内高度普遍，并在生物学和人类疾病中扮演重要角色。目前也认识到，许多IDPs即使在特定复合物和功能组装体中仍保持动态性。计算机模拟对于描述无序蛋白集合和动态相互作用的分子层面细节至关重要，以促进对IDPs在生物学、疾病和治疗中的机制性理解。在此，我们深入回顾了无序蛋白状态多尺度模拟的最新进展，特别强调用于研究IDPs的先进采样技术的发展与应用。这些技术对于充分采样IDPs众多功能相关构象空间至关重要。结合显著改进的蛋白质力场，这些先进模拟方法已取得实质性成功，并展现出对IDPs及其动态相互作用进行定量和预测性建模的巨大潜力。我们还将讨论在较大系统原子模拟中仍存在的关键挑战，以及各种粗粒化方法如何有助于弥合IDP模拟在可访问时间和长度尺度上的剩余差距。
